name: 仙侣情缘（知秋站 2001版）
english_description: A 2001 snapshot from the "Zhiqiu" site (www.mudfan.com), part of the Fairy Love Story engine family and a sibling to this project's separately archived "Zhejiang University edition" branch (xlqyzdb), but with earlier code closer to the original — a byte-level comparison puts the overlap at only about 10% of common-path files, versus the much tighter 84-86% overlap that xlqyzdb itself shares with two other siblings, "Immortal Companions' Bond (Early Test Build)" (xlqy_early) and "New Immortal Companions' Bond: Age of Mist" (xlqy_new2007). In-game it calls itself "A Journey to the West: Fairy Love Story." Players set out from an inn in southern Chang'an and cultivate through stages of the Tao, martial arts, and inner power toward a scripture-seeking, havoc-in-heaven-style story arc, with an overall casual pace.
